narrative.text: Presents WHO Summary Table 3 (updated December 2025) and its accompanying antigen notes (1–24), specifying minimum age of first dose, primary series intervals, rules for resuming interrupted series without repeating prior doses, catch-up regimens for children starting vaccination late (≤12 months versus >12 months of age), and booster recommendations across all 24 routine, regional, and high-risk antigens.

Provides the header, footnotes, and link to WHO position papers for the December 2025 edition of Summary Table 3 on recommendations for interrupted or delayed routine immunization, noting that expert opinion supplements position papers where formal catch-up recommendations are pending revision.
